# Automizer for Claude Desktop

> Machine-readable context file for LLM agents working with `automizer-for-claude-desktop`.
> Canonical Repository: https://github.com/dev-bricks/automizer-for-claude-desktop
> Ecosystem: dev-bricks | Umbrella: open-bricks
> License: MIT
> Last checked: 2026-08-21
> Test status: 23 passed (Pytest 9.1+)

## Overview & Architecture
`automizer-for-claude-desktop` is a local utility designed to safely manage, queue, and modify scheduled tasks for the official Claude Desktop app on Windows (and macOS/Linux supported paths).

Because the Claude Desktop application maintains its internal task registry (`scheduled-tasks.json`) in memory and overwrites the file on session teardown, direct file edits made while the app is active are silently lost. Automizer resolves this concurrency challenge by decoupling mutation requests into a staging queue (`_care/pending/pending-tasks.json`) and applying them atomically when the desktop app is closed.

## Repository Structure & Key Components
- `tools/claude_desktop_paths.py`: Dynamic path resolution helper for the registry file (`scheduled-tasks.json`) and task prompt directory (`<Documents>/Claude/Scheduled/`). Reads the Windows User Shell Folders registry key (`Personal`) to support OneDrive Known-Folder-Move redirection.
- `tools/queue_request.py`: CLI tool for enqueueing task modification (`set`) or creation (`create`) requests into `pending-tasks.json`.
- `tools/apply_pending_tasks.py`: Atomic merger engine. Checks if Claude Desktop is running, creates timestamped pre-write backups, merges queued changes into `scheduled-tasks.json`, performs post-write readback validation, and logs results to `applied-tasks.json`.
- `tools/install_merger_task.ps1`: PowerShell installer registering an hourly scheduled background task in Windows Task Scheduler.
- `tools/run_apply_pending_hidden.vbs`: VBScript wrapper executing the merger in windowless mode (`CREATE_NO_WINDOW`) without console popups.
- `prompts/`: Agent prompt templates:
  - `prompts/01_in-app_en.md` / `01_in-der-app.md`: Prompt injection for in-app Claude agents to stage modifications.
  - `prompts/02_from-outside-app-running_en.md` / `02_von-aussen-app-laeuft.md`: Instructions for external CLI agents when the app is active.
  - `prompts/03_app-closed_en.md` / `03_app-geschlossen.md`: Instructions for immediate execution when the app is verified closed.
- `skill/self-administration-of-scheduled-tasks/SKILL.md`: Claude Skill definition for automated self-management.
- `tests/test_automizer.py`: Pytest suite for platform detection, directory helpers, queue serialization, registry parsing, fail-closed cross-host handling, and path diagnostics.
- `tests/test_apply_pending_tasks.py`: Pytest suite for permission mode validation, fail-closed handling, rollback commands, and dry-run report generation.

## Key Operational Concepts
1. **Task Registry (`scheduled-tasks.json`)**: Contains task metadata, schedule (`cronExpression`), enabled state, model selection, and permissions. Located at `%APPDATA%\Claude\local-agent-mode-sessions\<session>\<account>\scheduled-tasks.json`.
2. **Task Prompt (`SKILL.md`)**: Contains the prompt instructions executed by Claude Desktop. Located at `<Documents>/Claude/Scheduled/<slug>/SKILL.md`.
3. **Pending Queue (`pending-tasks.json`)**: Stored at `<Documents>/Claude/Scheduled/_care/pending/pending-tasks.json`.
4. **History Log (`applied-tasks.json`)**: Stored at `<Documents>/Claude/Scheduled/_care/history/applied-tasks.json`.

## Safety Constraints & Whitelisting
- Process detection checks binary executable paths (`*WindowsApps*`) rather than simple process names, avoiding false collisions with the Claude Code CLI (`claude.exe`).
- Permitted registry mutation fields: `cronExpression`, `enabled`, `model`, `userSelectedFolders`, `permissionMode`, `disableJitter`.
- Disallowed mutations: Direct task deletion and arbitrary `filePath` reassignment.
- Self-protection guard (`CDA_SELF_PROTECT_PREFIX`) blocks accidental deactivation of supervisory maintenance tasks.

## Verification Commands
```bash
# Verify path resolution across system
python tools/apply_pending_tasks.py --paths

# Run comprehensive test suite
pytest

# Code style check
ruff check .
```
